title: Society
review: I only remembered the ending, from when I saw this almost 15 years ago. I was pleasantly surprised to see how well the rest of the film holds up, as Temu Marty McFly's life unravels and he looks for clues about his family's fucked up secret. It's another case of a character refusing to believe the more obvious explanation, that they are hallucinating, as they witness supernatural events. At the start, Bill believes the worms in the apple were in his mind. So why is he so sure of other less believable things he sees soon afterwards? It's funny to imagine Stanley Kubrick watching this and being inspired to make {Eyes Wide Shut}.
